turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for showing me round, Dov. I've had a look at the roof and the supply. The roof is a shallow metal one with plenty of room, so panels are no trouble.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You have a three-phase supply, which is what the kiln needs, so we'd fit a three-phase inverter. I'd suggest a 9 kilowatt array.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Would I need a battery as well?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I wouldn't start with one. You use most of your power in daylight, so the panels can feed the kiln directly. A battery can be added later.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That suits me. My landlord owns the building, though, so I'll need her permission before anything goes on the roof.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood. I'll send a one-page summary you can pass to her, and we'll hold the quote until you hear back.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you. I should have an answer from her by the end of the month.
